reason: The statement applies because the text shows that Yahweh communicates directly with the Israelites, not just their leaders. For instance, it mentions 'וַיִּזְעָ֑קוּ וַתַּ֧עַל שַׁוְעָתָ֛ם אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן־ הָעֲבֹדָֽה' which translates to 'And they cried out to God from their slavery, and their cry for help rose up to God.' This indicates that God heard the cries of the common people and responded.
